name: Radial bubble dynamics implementation with Python
description: Python code for the simulation of radial bubble dynamics and the generation of exemplary figures. We have implemented the Rayleigh-Plesset model and the Gilmore model for cavitation dynamics.

citation.name: Hannes P. Hoeppe et al., The collapse of a sonoluminescent cavitation bubble imaged with X-ray free-electron laser pulses, New Journal of Physics, Volume 26, March 2024. https://doi.org/10.1088/1367-2630/ad295b Malte Vassholz et al., Pump-probe X-ray holographic imaging of laser-induced cavitation bubbles with femtosecond FEL pulses, Nature Communications, 12 (1) art. 3468.(2021) DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-021-23664-1

distribution.name: radial_bubble_dynamics.ipynb
distribution.description: Jupyter Notebook with the implementation of radial bubble dynamics models, i.e. the Rayleigh-Plesset Model and the Gilmore Model. We simulated and compared the dynamics of an oscillating bubble in the SBSL regime, as well as the expansion of laser-induced bubbles. Compiled with Python 3.12.6
